beats.text: Single autonomous agents suffer from silent hallucinations and unconstrained state mutations.
Our engine decomposes high-stakes tasks across three specialized roles: Extractor, Risk Auditor, and Settlement Actuary.
Each agent independently evaluates input payloads using structured schemas and cryptographically checksummed outputs.
When at least two-thirds of agents agree on classification and risk parameters, the transaction commits in under twenty milliseconds.
When an agent proposes an invalid or disputed recommendation, the state machine detects the quorum breach and isolates the task.
Every vote, confidence score, and latency metric is immutably recorded for post-incident compliance audits.
